title: Keep Our Neighborhoods Safe
description: Garden Grove families and businesses deserve safe neighborhoods. Phat will make public safety a top priority, ensuring Garden Grove police officers and firefighters have the resources, staffing, and technology they need to reduce crime, protect our families, and keep our neighborhoods secure.

title: Demand Results on Homelessness
description: The homelessness crisis is hurting our neighborhoods and businesses. Phat will require measurable results from every taxpayer-funded program, enforce city laws to remove illegal encampments, and connect those who want help with mental health treatment, substance abuse services, and housing resources.

title: Protect Taxpayer Dollars
description: Garden Grove residents work hard for their money and deserve a City Hall that spends it wisely. Phat will demand responsible budgeting, greater transparency, and real accountability for every dollar spent. He will oppose unnecessary tax increases and work to eliminate government waste.

title: Strengthen Our Local Economy
description: A thriving local economy benefits every resident and neighborhood. Phat will support small businesses, attract new and responsible investment, cut red tape, and create more local jobs so Garden Grove families can work, succeed, and build their futures right here in our community.
